title: Proper ordinary native module direct image preserves bounded constructibility
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l unequal to D.p, and a normalized realization Family F [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization]. For separated finite-type geometric spaces Z,T and a proper k-morphism p:Z→T, let O be any Operations for the realizations F.data Z.realization and F.data T.realization [def-sf-native-proper-coefficient-operations]. Then for every ordinary module derived object K satisfying boundedConstructible_Z(K), the object ContinuousRational.DirectImage.derivedPush(p,O.coefficient)(K) satisfies boundedConstructible_T. The coefficient map has O.functions precomposition normalization; neither an isomorphism a or b nor any adjunction-comparison equation is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization to $f=p$ with the compactification $(\mathrm{id}_Z,p)$. It supplies the proper scalar-extension comparison on the stated full ordinary derived subcategories; for this compactification $D(\mathrm{id}_!)$ is the identity (extension by zero across the entire scheme). In particular its final preservation clause says that the actual $Rp_{*,B}$ sends $\mathcal D_Z$ into $\mathcal D_Y$. The domain called $D^b_{ctf}(-,\Omega)$ in that lemma is exactly the common-stage $D^b_c(-,\Omega)$ by def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, so no extra Tor hypothesis is being imposed on objects of $\mathcal C_Z$. Step 1 identifies its realization $J$ with $\rho$. We use this result here only to restrict the independently defined ordinary module direct image; its comparison need not be chosen as our $b_p$. Transport its native ordinary presentation through the section-module equivalence of the fixed Family. The precomposition property of Operations identifies the coefficient map, hence the ordinary pullback functor; uniqueness of right adjoints identifies the actual right-derived direct images. This identification transports boundedConstructible, independent of the auxiliary realization chosen by compact-support realization.

theorem adic_proper_ordinary_push_preservation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) (F : Family l D)
    (Z T : GeometricSpace D) (p : Z.base ⟶ T.base)
    (hp : IsProper p.left)
    (O : Operations l p.left (F.data Z).realization (F.data T).realization) :
    ∀ K, boundedConstructible l Z.base.left (F.data Z).realization K →
      boundedConstructible l T.base.left (F.data T).realization
        ((ContinuousRational.DirectImage.derivedPush p.left O.coefficient).obj K)
